comparisons.peer_topic: Accounting measurement and fee recognition for loans
comparisons.peer_summary: Loans are reported at outstanding principal net of unearned income, charge-offs, and deferred fees, with origination fees and direct costs deferred and recognized over the loan life using a constant effective yield methodology.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and Bank of America (BAC) describe loans held for investment as being accounted for at amortized cost, which includes net deferred fees and unamortized premiums/discounts. GS quantifies these adjustments as less than 1% of the loans, while BAC describes the methodology of deferring origination fees and direct costs to be recognized over the loan life using a constant effective yield methodology, without providing a specific relative magnitude.

sentences.text: • Loans held for investment that are accounted for at amortized cost include net deferred fees and costs, and unamortized premiums and discounts, which are amortized over the life of the loan. These amounts were less than 1% of loans accounted for at amortized cost as of both December 2024 and December 2023.

Loans, with the exception of loans accounted for under the fair value option, are reported at their outstanding principal balances net of any unearned income, charge-offs, unamortized deferred fees and costs on originated loans, and for purchased loans, net of any unamortized premiums or discounts.
Loan origination fees and certain direct origination costs are deferred and recognized as adjustments to interest income over the lives of the related loans.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition of recorded investment in loans
comparisons.peer_summary: Recorded investment in a loan includes net deferred loan fees and costs, unamortized premium or discount, less any direct write-downs.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and Citigroup (C) define the composition of the recorded investment in loans held for investment, specifically noting the inclusion of net deferred loan fees/costs and unamortized premiums/discounts. GS highlights that these items were less than 1% of the total, while C provides the definition of recorded investment including these same components but without the quantitative disclosure regarding their relative size.

comparisons.peer_topic: Loans held-for-investment accounting basis and components
comparisons.peer_summary: Originated or purchased loans held-for-investment are recorded at amortized cost, reflecting the principal amount outstanding net of unamortized fees, costs, premiums, discounts, charge-offs, cash collections, and foreign exchange effects, with credit card loans additionally including billed finance charges and fees.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and JPMorgan (JPM) identify that loans held for investment are recorded at amortized cost, which reflects the principal amount net of unamortized deferred loan fees, costs, premiums, or discounts. GS notes that these specific components (fees/premiums/discounts) comprised less than 1% of the amortized cost loans in both periods, whereas JPM lists these items as standard deductions from the outstanding principal in its accounting policy without providing a materiality threshold or percentage.

sentences.text: • Loans held for investment that are accounted for at amortized cost include net deferred fees and costs, and unamortized premiums and discounts, which are amortized over the life of the loan. These amounts were less than 1% of loans accounted for at amortized cost as of both December 2024 and December 2023.

Originated or purchased loans held-for-investment, including PCD, are recorded at amortized cost, reflecting the principal amount outstanding, net of the following: unamortized deferred loan fees, costs, premiums or discounts; charge-offs; collection of cash; and foreign exchange.

comparisons.peer_topic: Loans Held for Investment Valuation Basis
comparisons.peer_summary: Loans held for investment are reported at amortized cost, which consists of the outstanding principal balance adjusted for charge-offs, allowance for credit losses, and unamortized deferred fees, costs, premiums, or discounts.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Morgan Stanley (MS) disclose that their loans held for investment are accounted for at amortized cost and include adjustments for unamortized deferred fees, costs, premiums, or discounts. GS explicitly states these amounts were less than 1% of such loans in both 2024 and 2023, while MS provides the general valuation basis without quantifying the percentage of these adjustments relative to the loan portfolio.

sentences.text: • Loans held for investment that are accounted for at amortized cost include net deferred fees and costs, and unamortized premiums and discounts, which are amortized over the life of the loan. These amounts were less than 1% of loans accounted for at amortized cost as of both December 2024 and December 2023.

Loans held for investment are reported at amortized cost, which consists of the outstanding principle balance adjusted for any charge-offs, the allowance for credit losses, any unamortized deferred fees or costs for originated loans, and any unamortized premiums or discounts for purchased loans.
